cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your old tutor is stumped. Why is the soup staying in that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, don't pretend you know. Change one thing, like we practised: turn the spoon over and watch the soup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon sets which way is down. You finally watched the result instead of your hand. Point it into the sink before we test letting go.

reason: State the crucial inferred directional rule plainly so the safe next experiment follows without guessing at ungrammatical shorthand.
